Automated test run

How I tested this portfolio

23 November 2026 at 13:44, Stockholm time.

Chromium 153.0.8010.12 · Firefox 155.0

I ran these automated checks in desktop browsers at several screen widths. The results reflect browser simulations. Testing on physical devices and a full WCAG audit were outside the scope of this run.
